title: radiance
description: radiance: throughput, speculation by draft position, scheduler, latency, prefix cache, HTTP. Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics.

panels.title: Decode
panels.description: Generated tokens per second, counted when the step commits.

panels.title: Prefill computed
panels.description: Prompt tokens per second the engine actually computed; prefix-cache hits are not in it.

panels.title: KV cache
panels.description: Above about 75% the prefix cache starts evicting prefixes the next turn wants.

panels.title: Draft acceptance
panels.description: Accepted over proposed draft tokens over the time range. Conditional on having drafted: read it together with draft blocks per decode step.

panels.title: Prompt from attention cache
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the paged attention prefix cache over the time range (vllm:gpu_prefix_cache_hit_rate is the same ratio since start).

panels.title: Prompt from linear checkpoint
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens whose recurrent state came from a checkpoint over the time range (radiance:linear_prefix_cache_hit_rate since start). A prompt can be fully attention-cached and still re-run every recurrent layer.

panels.title: Decode step time
panels.description: engine_step_seconds_decode_total / engine_steps_decode_total over the time range: decode only. Wall clock over steps would charge idle and prefill to it.

panels.title: Draft blocks per decode step
panels.description: Verified draft blocks per decode-only step over the time range. Falls when rows stop drafting, which the acceptance ratio does not show.

panels.title: Prefix evictions
panels.description: Over the time range. The leading indicator of a prefix-cache collapse: it rises while a reusable prefix is dropped, before the hit rate falls.

panels.title: Refused / failed
panels.description: Over the time range.

panels.title: Prompt tokens by source
panels.description: Per second. The two cache series are not additive: one token can be served from both.

panels.title: Conditional acceptance by draft position
panels.description: In the window: of the verifies that reached position j, the fraction that took j as well. Position j+1 is reached only when j was accepted, so this is reached(j+1) / reached(j); the last position is the total accepted minus every later reach. A late position that collapses while the pooled rate looks fine shows here first.

panels.title: Conditional acceptance by draft position (since start)
panels.description: The server's own gauge, cumulative since the process started.

panels.title: Tokens per verify
panels.description: What speculation buys one sequence: 1 + accepted tokens per verify.

panels.title: Draft reach by position
panels.description: Verifies that evaluated each position, per second: how much evidence each acceptance carries. High reach with acceptance near zero is a broken draft round.

panels.title: Draft blocks per decode step
panels.description: Verified draft blocks over decode-only steps. The acceptance ratio is conditional on having drafted and reads healthy while this collapses.

panels.title: Decode rows without a draft
panels.description: Decode rows that took no draft, for any reason, per second.

panels.title: Step time
panels.description: Seconds inside one scheduler step; with speculation a step includes its draft rounds. Decode only is the comparable number.

panels.title: Engine busy, steps issued ahead
panels.description: Busy: share of wall time inside a step. Issued ahead: share of steps whose forward pass was issued behind the step before, ahead of its commit.

panels.title: Prefix hit rate
panels.description: In the window, with the definitions of vllm:gpu_prefix_cache_hit_rate and radiance:linear_prefix_cache_hit_rate.
